message:
Ticket 5033 is open in the Billing team and assigned to you. It's a customer conversation with Alex Morgan (alex.morgan@customer.example). The last message, from 28 Oct, asks for an update.

Forwarding sends the whole conversation to maria.lopez@lopez-cpa.example, and I can't undo that. It would share a customer's details with an outside party. Should I forward the full ticket as is, or do you want a note added? If you want a note, tell me what it should say.
